title: reader/config.rs: pub use UserCredential buried under wrong section comment
description: In crates/reader/src/config.rs, 'pub use stoa_auth::UserCredential' (line 7) appears directly under the comment '// Types are defined in stoa_core::ipfs_backend and re-exported here so that reader config validation code can use them without a long path prefix.' This comment describes the ipfs_backend re-exports below it, not the UserCredential re-export. A maintainer scanning this file could read the section header as referring only to ipfs_backend types, miss the stoa_auth re-export entirely, and add a duplicate local UserCredential struct. The fix is to either: (a) add a dedicated comment on line 7 explaining the re-export ('// Re-exported from stoa-auth so callers get UserCredential from config, not stoa_auth directly'), or (b) move the UserCredential re-export to a visually distinct block near the AuthConfig fields it relates to.
